newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia mortgage rates average 9.03 pct - REI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia mortgage rates average 9.03 pct - REI.

text.p: The average mortgage rate for owner occupied mortgages in Australia was 9.03 percent in September against 10.17 percent a year earlier, the Real Estate of Institute of New South Wales (REI) said on Friday.
The average for investment mortgages was 9.22 percent compared with 10.59 percent, the REI said in its REI/Rate Check Book Home Loan Monitor.
The REI said the variable owner-occupied rates ranged from 8.3 percent to 9.95 percent while residential investment rates ranged from 8.3 percent to 11.5 percent.
"The Rate Check Book indicates that mortgage interest rates are staying down," REI president Robert Weight said.

"Coupled with improved consumer confidence and an expectation of steady growth in the property market, the indicators are pointed in the right direction for a strengthening property market during 1996/97," Weight said.

The monthly survey calculates the overall costs of mortgages and includes an annual percentage rate based on the nominal rate, upfront fees and annual fees. The REI surveyed 68 products for owner occupied loans and 64 products for investment loans.
"With property prices in most areas still at reasonable levels housing affordability remains attractive," Weight said.
"The institute believes that people planning to upgrade or purchase their first home will find finance availability and market conditions at the moment very much their favour."
